critical_code_review_comments: Speedo.jsx – children-prop pattern is clean and backward-compatible; default path still renders static value/label divs when no children passed. Good API design.

About.jsx – Editable wraps the value/label with matching classes (mt-[-14px] font-display, mt-2 text-[10px] tracking-[0.2em]) – styling is preserved even in edit mode. text-center class added so contentEditable expands full width for easier click-to-edit.

WhySafeRide.jsx – switching from SPANS asymmetric layout to grid-cols-3 is a substantial simplification (removed ~30 lines of hard-coded col-span logic). Consider extracting the ACCENTS array to a constants file if reused elsewhere.

CantonWappen.jsx – nice detail using stable code detection (\\b(SZ|ZH|SG|GR)\\b) before falling back to full-name matching – avoids false positives like 'sz' matching inside 'Schwyz'. Testid pattern canton-wappen-<code> is consistent and testable.
Marquee.jsx – edit-mode view uses a raw <input> instead of the shared Editable component. Works fine but inconsistent with the rest of the codebase. Not blocking.

Startup migration (_migrate_why_pillar_bodies_short) is idempotent and safe – checks each pillar's body_de against old default snapshot before rewriting. Force-patched wp5 (previously edited by user) is acceptable one-time correction.
